title: Director of Support Engineering
description:
About The Role

As a Director of Support Engineering, you will play a crucial role in ensuring that our clients receive the highest level of technical support and service. We are looking for a dynamic leader who is passionate about customer satisfaction and has a strong technical background. If you, we want to hear from you.

This role is a good fit for someone who thrives in a fast‑paced, innovative environment and has a proven track record of managing successful technical support teams.

Responsibilities

  • Building, mentoring, and inspiring a high‑performing distributed team of Support Engineers, fostering a culture of excellence, accountability, and AI‑driven innovation
  • Leading AI‑first transformations of support workflows and decision‑making processes, embedding intelligent systems into daily operations to enhance speed, accuracy, and quality
  • Owning and optimizing core support processes including ticket management, incident response and escalation procedures
  • Establishing and monitoring performance metrics across the team ensuring high performance and efficient operations
  • Ensuring compliance with service level agreements and maintaining high levels of customer retention
  • Identifying training and development needs for the technical support team and providing resources and support for their professional growth
  • Designing and implementing enterprise‑grade support processes and service delivery models
  • Acting as a senior escalation leader during critical incidents, providing clear, calm, and strategic guidance to both internal teams and customer executives
  • Fostering a positive and collaborative work culture within the technical support team, promoting teamwork and employee engagement
  • Championing cross‑functional alignment by working closely with Customer Success, Product, Engineering, and Professional Services to drive shared goals and frictionless customer experiences
  • Driving strategic initiatives in partnership with senior leadership to evolve the vision, strategy, and operating model of the Technical Support function in an AI‑first world

About the Team

We’re a tight‑knit team of tech pros who love tackling tough problems. No challenge is too big—we dig deep to find the right answers every time. We’ve got each other’s backs and are always looking for ways to grow, improve, and deliver better results together. Our culture is all about learning, growing, and making a meaningful impact. We don’t stop until we’ve found the best solution, and we’re always ready to jump in and support one another. By working as a team, we consistently deliver high‑quality results—and we keep raising the bar. Even when things get hectic, we stay calm, focused, and solutions‑driven. Clear communication is one of our core strengths, ensuring both our partners and teammates get the support they need. We’re committed to doing the job right, no matter what, and we pride ourselves on staying close to our partners to make sure they have exactly what they need to succeed.

What You’ll Do

Within 3 months, you will:

  • Learn company products, services, and customer base in depth
  • Understand support tools, systems, workflows, and escalation processes
  • Review existing KPIs
  • Build Team & Stakeholder Relationships
  • Identify quick wins in ticket handling, response times, or escalation paths
  • Meet with direct reports and cross‑functional leaders (Engineering, Product, Sales, Customer Success)

Within 6 months, you will:

  • Establish clear roles, responsibilities, and expectations
  • Introduce a quality control motion to ensure fixes are properly tested
  • Build robust onboarding program for new hires allowing them to be effective quickly and predictably
  • Improve reporting and analytics dashboards for visibility into KPIs
  • Begin designing long‑term support strategies (e.g., self‑service improvements, tiered support models)

Within 9 months, you will:

  • Build a culture of accountability, customer empathy, and continuous improvement
  • Delight cross‑functional partners and stakeholders: Customer Success, Engineering, Solutions Consulting
  • Recognize and reward top performers
  • Launch a roadmap for scaling support operations (e.g., automation, AI chatbots, advanced knowledge management)

What You’ll Bring

  • 5+ years of experience in technical support for enterprise software or SaaS platforms, with a strong emphasis on driving innovation through automation and AI
  • 3+ years in leadership roles, with a proven ability to build and scale high‑impact support organizations in fast‑paced, AI‑forward environments
  • Proven ability to lead and develop organizations of 20+ employees including management of managers
  • Demonstrated success building globally distributed, high‑performing teams, with a focus on asynchronous collaboration, operational resilience, and intelligent tooling
  • Exceptional communication skills, capable of distilling complex technical topics for both executive‑level and technical audiences across varied customer profiles
  • Deep expertise in enterprise SaaS platforms cloud architectures and complex B2B software solutions
  • Demonstrated ability to develop and execute enterprise‑level strategies with measurable business impact

What’s In It For You

  • Remote Flexibility: Enjoy the freedom of remote work from anywhere, balancing life and career seamlessly.
  • Unforgettable Off‑Sites: Twice a year, bond with colleagues in exciting destinations, fostering teamwork and fresh ideas.
  • Paid Time Off and National Holidays: Enjoy 20 PTO days yearly and the National Holidays for relaxation and rejuvenation.
  • Stock Options: Joining us means having a stake in our success, so you’ll receive stock options as part of your compensation package.
  • Home Office Setup: Create your ideal workspace with a dedicated budget for home office essentials.
  • Work Trip Budget: Grow personally and professionally with a budget for work‑related trips and co‑working.

About Us

Clutch is a revolutionary vertical SaaS company, proudly backed by Andreessen Horowitz (A16z), aimed at revolutionizing the way Credit Unions engage and change the lives of their members. As a champion of financial well‑being, we address the urgent need for affordable lending solutions in an era where the average American grapples with over $155,000 in household debt. Unlike traditional financial institutions, Clutch develops software to turn Credit Unions into FinTech lenders and leverage their balance sheets to responsibly lend to over 130M Americans. Our mission extends beyond mere financial transactions; we strive to fundamentally enhance the way credit unions interact with their members. By integrating cutting‑edge technologies and user‑centric designs, we help credit unions provide seamless digital experiences that are on par with leading tech companies. This approach not only preserves but revitalizes the longstanding tradition of community and member‑focused service inherent to credit unions.

Please note: This position is offered on a contractor basis. Applicants must have the necessary documentation and authorization to work in the country where the job is located. Clutch cannot provide sponsorship or assist with obtaining work permits for this role.

A Note About AI At Clutch: We love AI. We use it often and encourage our team to creatively and effectively leverage AI tools in their work. If you join Clutch, we hope you’ll bring the same enthusiasm for exploring how AI can amplify impact, productivity, and innovation. That said, during the interview process, we want to hear your thoughts. Please approach interviews without the use of AI tools—our goal is to get to know how you think, solve problems, and communicate. Once you're in the seat, bring on the prompts!

title: Engenheiro a de dados pleno e senior
description:
Engenheiro(a) de Dados - Pleno e Senior

Junte-se à Netvagas e pós sua candidatura ao cargo de Engenheiro(a) de Dados - Pleno e Senior.

Pessoa Engenheira de Dados - 100% Remoto.

Sobre o Time

O time de Data Hub do Banco Carrefour é o núcleo de dados para o Centro de Excelência de Martech, e é responsável por construir e manter a infraestrutura de dados que alimenta as decisões estratégicas do time. Buscamos uma pessoa Engenheira de Dados que seja apaixonada por construir pipelines de dados robustos, escaláveis e eficientes, com experiência em ambientes cloud e familiaridade com o universo de dados de marketing e digital analytics. Se você é proativo, adora desafios e tem sede de aprendizado, essa vaga é para você!

No seu dia-a-dia

  • Projetar, construir e manter pipelines de dados (ETL/ELT) para integrar dados de diversas fontes, incluindo plataformas de marketing, digital analytics e outras fontes de dados internas e externas.
  • Otimizar a performance e a escalabilidade dos pipelines de dados.
  • Monitorar a qualidade dos dados e implementar soluções para garantir a acurácia e a consistência dos dados.
  • Colaborar com outras equipes (Data Science, Business Intelligence, Marketing) para entender as necessidades e garantir que a infraestrutura de dados atenda às demandas do negócio.
  • Documentar processos e soluções de engenharia de dados.
  • Participar ativamente da definição da arquitetura de dados e da escolha de novas tecnologias.
  • Implementar práticas de DataOps para garantir a qualidade, a confiabilidade e a governança dos dados.

Perfil Desejado

  • Perfil analítico e orientado a resultados, com foco na entrega de soluções de dados de alta qualidade.
  • Proatividade, paixão por aprender e vontade de enfrentar novos desafios.
  • Excelente capacidade de comunicação e colaboração para trabalhar em equipe e interagir com diferentes áreas da empresa.
  • Forte senso de responsabilidade e compromisso com a qualidade do trabalho.

Requisitos

Competências Técnicas

  • Experiência comprovada com desenvolvimento de pipelines de dados (ETL/ELT) utilizando ferramentas como Python, Apache Spark, Apache Airflow ou similares.
  • Proficiência em SQL e experiência com bancos de dados relacionais e não relacionais.
  • Experiência sólida com plataformas de cloud computing (GCP, AWS, Azure, etc.) e seus serviços de dados (ex.: Dataflow, Dataproc, S3, Azure Data Lake Storage).
  • Experiência com modelagem de dados e design de data warehouses e data lakes.
  • Familiaridade com práticas de DataOps e ferramentas de CI/CD.
  • Background com dados de Marketing e/ou Digital Analytics (Google Analytics 4, Plataformas de mídia, CRM, etc).

Diferenciais

  • Experiência com plataformas de dados como BigQuery, Snowflake e Databricks.
  • Experiência com Dataform e/ou DBT.
  • Experiência com Salesforce Marketing Cloud.
  • Experiência com ferramentas de orquestração de dados como Airflow, Dagster ou Prefect.
  • Conhecimento de metodologias ágeis (Scrum, Kanban).
  • Contribuições para projetos open source relacionados a dados.
  • Certificações em plataformas de cloud computing (GCP, AWS, Azure).

Informações Adicionais

  • Modelo de contratação PJ.
  • Modelo de Atuação Home Office.

Benefícios

  • R$500,00 de Ajuda de Custo.

title: Surveyor I
description:
Overview

The Surveyor I is an entry or junior-level position for new graduates and/or those with less than five (5) years of experience in an applicable industry. The Surveyor I, under a direct supervisor, performs work involving conventional surveying practices. The primary function is to develop the ability to effectively examine and report on vessels and other marine structures during and after construction relative to compliance with the applicable requirements for maintaining the vessel in Classification with ABS and meeting associated statutory and special service requirements related to Safety of Life at Sea, Loadline, Tonnage, Cargo Gear and Pollution Prevention Certification.

What You Will Do (with the assistance and guidance of an experienced ABS Surveyor)

  • Acts as a professional specialist for the organization in the application of related rules, regulations, requirements, concepts, principles, and processes.
  • Performs routine surveys on classed vessels, platforms, or other marine structures and at manufacturers for classification and compliance with statutory requirements.
  • Prepares technically accurate and timely reports of inspections and surveys performed.
  • Engages in contact with clients to resolve problems within areas of expertise.
  • Maintains survey files in an orderly and up-to-date manner in the area of responsibility.
  • Develops the skills necessary for the administration of office procedures and monitoring of business performance at an assigned port.
  • Through broader and more technically challenging work assignments, the individual must develop a thorough understanding of field operations, policies, methods, and procedures.

What You Will Need

Education and Experience

  • Qualifications from a tertiary institution within a relevant field of engineering or physical science (minimum two (2) years program); or
  • Qualifications from a marine or nautical institution and relevant seagoing experience as a certificated ship officer, and
  • Proficiency in the English language commensurate with the scope of statutory certification and services and, before assignment, with their future work.
  • Appropriate certification and/or licenses in areas of specialization may be required.

Knowledge, Skills, And Abilities

  • Ability to develop a working knowledge of ABS Rules, Guides, statutory regulations, and related instructions, as well as the ABS Employee Safety Policy.
  • Ability to read engineering plans and have a basic understanding of shipbuilding practices and vessel operations.
  • Ability to perform surveys in the prescribed format.
  • Knowledge of computer programs or software packages related to job responsibilities.
  • Knowledge of related technical interfaces required for group project work.
  • Knowledge of ships' engineering systems and machinery.
  • Ability to communicate, orally and in writing, pertinent information relative to assigned area of technical expertise.
  • Ability to analyze problems and propose solutions.
  • Responsiveness to customers and the ability to work well with others.
  • Ability to become familiar with the ABS Health, Safety, Quality, and Environmental Management Systems.

Physical Requirements

  • Where allowed by local laws, a pre-employment physical examination is mandatory.
  • The role of surveyor/auditor requires sufficient physical strength, stamina, agility, and both visual and auditory acuity to perform the listed duties effectively.
  • The ability to climb vertical ladders up to nine meters and navigate steep steps is essential.
  • Shall be capable of working at heights on various staging and lifting equipment.
  • Shall be able to maneuver in tight spaces and work inside confined areas for extended periods, including kneeling and crawling.
  • The role may involve exposure to industrial environments, potential injury risks, extreme weather conditions, and demanding physical activities.
  • Shall be able to lift at least 25 lbs. / 11.34 kgs.
  • The use of small tools and the wearing of Personal Protective Equipment (PPE), in accordance with ABS safety procedures, may be required.
  • Where allowed by local laws, the surveyor will be required to successfully complete an annual physical that will recertify the individual can perform the physical actions required.

Reporting Relationships

Will report to the Principal, Senior, or Surveyor-in-Charge of the assigned port. This position does not have any direct reports.

About Us

We set out more than 160 years ago to promote the security of life and property at sea and preserve the natural environment. Today, we remain true to our mission and continue to support organizations facing a rapidly evolving seascape of challenging regulations and new technologies. Through it all, we are anchored by a vision and mission that help our clients find clarity in uncertain times.

ABS is a global leader in marine and offshore classification and other innovative safety, quality, and environmental services. We’re at the forefront of supporting the global energy transition at sea, the application of remote and autonomous marine systems, cutting-edge technical solutions, and many more exciting advancements. Our commitment to safety, reliability, and efficiency is ever-present, guiding our clients to safer and more efficient operations.

Equal Opportunity

ABS Bureau is committed to the equal employment opportunity of its employees and prohibits discrimination against any employee or qualified applicant based on race, color, creed, religion, national origin, sex, gender identity, age, disability, marital status, sexual orientation, citizenship status or veteran status, or other non-work-related characteristics that may be protected under the law of the Federal Government or specific state employment laws.

Notice

ABS and Affiliated Companies (ABS) will not pay a fee to any third-party agency without a valid ABS Master Service Agreement (MSA) authorized and signed by Human Resources. Any resume, CV, application, or other forms of candidate submission provided to any employee of ABS without a valid MSA on file will be considered property of ABS, and no fee will be paid.

Other

This job description is not intended, and should not be construed, to be an all-inclusive list of responsibilities, skills, efforts or working conditions associated with the job of the incumbent. It is intended to be an accurate reflection of the principal job elements essential for making a fair decision regarding the pay structure of the job. #ogjs

title: [Rio de Janeiro] Gerente Paula Cotrim | Vendas - Seguros de Vida e Previdência (Autônomo - Atua[...]
description:
Overview

(Rio de Janeiro) Gerente Paula Cotrim | Vendas - Seguros de Vida e Previdência (Autônomo - Atuação Presencial)

Descrição da vaga: Quer redirecionar sua carreira profissional, aprender uma nova profissão e iniciar seu próprio negócio? Venha atuar como Corretor de Vida e Previdência na MAG Seguros! Você ingressará no nosso Programa para Formação de Novos Corretores, onde aprenderá tudo sobre Seguro de Vida e Previdência. Realizará o curso preparatório para o exame de Habilitação Técnico Profissional e, ao ser aprovado, terá sua licença para atuar como Corretor de Seguros, começando o seu próprio negócio, com todo o suporte e expertise da MAG Seguros.

Responsabilidades e atribuições

  • Você atuará como profissional autônomo com as seguintes atribuições:
  • Inicialmente, se dedicará exclusivamente ao curso preparatório da MAG Universidade para obtenção da habilitação técnico profissional junto a Susep;
  • Após a conquista da Habilitação:
  • Identificará potenciais clientes para abordar, utilizando sua Rede de Relacionamento para agendamento de entrevistas de vendas e solicitação de indicações;
  • Fará telemarketing ativo para agendar entrevistas de vendas;
  • Realizará as entrevistas de vendas, identificando as necessidades de proteção financeira do prospect e ofertando as soluções mais adequadas a cada perfil;
  • Gerenciará a sua carteira de clientes com foco na sustentabilidade financeira do seu negócio.

Requisitos e qualificações

  • Ensino médio completo;
  • Aptidão para vendas;
  • Amplo círculo social (network/ rede de relacionamento);
  • Perfil ativo nas redes sociais;

Você se diferenciará

  • Experiência como profissional autônomo, liberal ou empreendedor;
  • Experiência com venda consultiva e rotina de vendas externas.

Informações adicionais

  • PESSOAS BEM-SUCEDIDAS NESSA PROFISSÃO: São aguerridas, motivadas, resilientes e persistentes, dedicando à construção do sucesso de seu próprio negócio;
  • Identificam-se com o propósito de despertar nas pessoas o desejo e a necessidade de assegurar o próprio futuro e o das pessoas que amam;
  • Possuem ampla rede de relacionamento, frequentam grupos sociais ligados a esporte, religião, hobbies, culinária, educação, negócios ou qualquer outro tema que permita estar em contato frequente com diferentes pessoas, ampliando o círculo social;
  • Possuem como prioridades o sucesso profissional e os ganhos financeiros, independente de regime de contratação de trabalho;
  • Têm disponibilidade para atuar conforme agenda do cliente, possuindo flexibilidade na rotina de trabalho, para atendimento além dos horários convencionais;
  • Atuam com disciplina no planejamento semanal das atividades de vendas, de acordo com os parâmetros necessários para o atingimento e superação dos objetivos financeiros e pessoais;
  • Dedicam-se ao estudo contínuo em busca de novos conhecimentos, mantendo-se atualizadas profissionalmente.

Já pensou em redirecionar sua carreira ou aprender uma nova profissão? Agora imagine só, poder fazer isso sendo parceiro de uma empresa que, há quase 200 anos, ajuda as pessoas a planejar um futuro financeiro mais tranquilo. Aqui na MAG, nossos corretores parceiros são chamados de Especialistas em Proteção Financeira. E se você tem tino comercial, gosta de se relacionar com pessoas, tem perfil empreendedor e deseja trabalhar com o forte propósito de prover soluções financeiras individuais nos diversos momentos de vida de todos os brasileiros, nosso Programa para Formação de Especialistas em Proteção Financeira é a oportunidade ideal para você!

Sabemos bem que um processo de mudança de carreira pode ser algo difícil. Mas, participando de nosso Programa, você terá todo o suporte necessário para ser bem sucedido, desde o treinamento em sala de aula - onde aprenderá mais sobre a empresa, seu portfólio e o processo de vendas – até o acompanhamento em campo, onde realizará - com a supervisão de nossos líderes especialistas - as primeiras entrevistas de vendas.

Conheça as vantagens de se tornar Especialistas em Proteção Financeira parceiro da MAG Seguros

  • Além de toda estrutura de suporte, treinamento e acompanhamento, poderemos apoiá-lo financeiramente na fase inicial de constituição de seu negócio, mediante o atingimento de critérios mínimos de produtividade.
  • Subsídios de até 70% para adquirir produtos como plano de saúde, de telefonia móvel, seguros de vida, notebook e smartphone, mediante elegibilidade ao nosso Programa de Fidelidade
  • Comissionamento vitalício sobre grande parte das coberturas comercializadas, ou seja, a comissão é do corretor pelo tempo em que o contrato do cliente estiver ativo, permitindo ganhos ilimitados.
  • Atuação presencial, com relacionamento multicanal, que pode ser realizado via unidades de vendas, telefone, WhatsApp, e-mail e chat, além de portal exclusivo para corretores.
  • Campanhas de vendas periódicas, que premiam os vencedores, além do reconhecimento e distinção, com incríveis viagens de turismo ou de desenvolvimento. Acesse vida.mag.com.br/mag-365.
  • Conversão das vendas em pontos que podem ser trocados por mais de 50 mil itens disponíveis em um catálogo virtual.

Sobre a MAG: Com mais de 6 milhões de clientes e cerca de R$ 475 bilhões assegurados, somos especialistas no desenvolvimento de soluções personalizadas em seguros de vida e planos de previdência individuais e corporativos. Em 2009, nos associamos ao Grupo Aegon, presente em mais de 20 países ao redor do mundo. Hoje, somos a terceira maior seguradora independente do Brasil e contamos com 38 unidades de vendas físicas espalhadas pelo Brasil, que servem de base para o trabalho de mais de seis mil corretores parceiros.

The Opportunity

  • Start part-time freelance; earn your way into a full-time seat within 12 months based on results.

Are you passionate about data and data quality and integrity? Do you enjoy using Python and AI to analyze and manipulate data, detect data quality issues, and visualize your findings? Are you highly customer-focused with excellent attention to detail?

REGIONAL ACCOUNT MANAGER MLAC - FCM

Regional Account Manager (Latin America)

To learn more about FCM please click HERE

About The Opportunity

  • This specific role of Regional Account Management is designed to manage the relationship between FCM Travel Solutions and clients.
  • FCM OBW Experts are designed to lead by demonstrated performance within the business and be experts within all facets of their AM role.
  • The provision of these travel programs will be in accordance with the global and/or regional agreement. The strategic intent of these programs will be to provide consolidation, which in turn delivers savings through spend leverage, tightened program control and consistent operational services.

Client programs will be built on agreed global and regional requirements whilst taking into consideration local market diversities.

Key Responsibilities

  • OBW Expert to conduct regular reviews with (region) based FCM Partner Account Managers (AMs).
  • Ensure areas of required training for the role, business acumen and FCM product suite are undertaken by AM.
  • Ensure organic growth is encouraged and streamlined within the region. Use lighthouse to track and monitor.

  • Guide AMs to access online libraries in Lighthouse and the FCM Global Extranet and access current documents and templates as required.
  • Provide input into FCM’s Account Management global procedures through monitoring competitive activity across the industry, requirements of our FCM partners and requirements of our clients.
  • OBW Expert to engage with FCM Multinational Account Manager and the Network Leader(s) (Region) and provide feedback of local market FCM partner performance.
  • Develop and execute a multinational business plan, detailing objectives, strategies and measurable targets, deployed with each local Account Manager.
  • In partnership with local country FCM Account Managers complete a regular assessment of the client travel program in relation to the business plan.
  • Direct Savings - Review opportunities and cost benefits for supplier contracts. Ensure local country supplier contracts are benchmarked and assistance provided to local/regional client during contract supplier negotiations.

  • Prescribe results on savings and maintain across the region.

Ensure client exposure to secondary products and services; expense management solutions, MIR, accounts payable solutions (billing platforms), hotel programs, travel booking procedures (online technology) and event management (CIEvents).
  • Using the Service Level Agreement work with local country FCM Account Managers and Operational teams to drive a common service delivery for the client. Ensure consistent interpretation and administration of travel policy, utilisation of negotiated supplier deals and implementation of business plan to drive client goals.
  • Responsible for the multinational client implementation plan, coordinating all departments and function groups (Online Booking Tools, Global Reporting, Operations, Products, Sales, Change Management & Communication, Credit/Payments).
  • Work with local country FCM Account Managers to provide assistance to the client for local, multi-market and/or global supplier agreements (airlines, car rental, insurance). Hotel program procurement should be managed by the FCM Hotel Product team.
  • Ability to prepare annual Airline Opportunity Analysis for client(s) and conduct annual Travel Policy Opportunity analysis and assessment including benchmarking to like clients.
  • Provide recommendations to clients on strategic direction of program in respect to booking, payment settlement and compliance benchmarked to like clients.
  • Maintain a central reference source file for the Operational and Account Management teams managing regional clients, containing client policies, forms, templates, procedures and client negotiated supplier information.
  • Maintain accurate and up to date client information in FCM Lighthouse. Ensure all company hierarchy, client contacts, important communications, contracts, monthly/quarterly/annual reporting and reviews are recorded in the account record. All time on events and tasks to be recorded against the client profile.
  • Represent the client within FCM and communicate required matters of contractual delivery.
  • Be the first point of contact for the client’s multinational Travel Manager and all key stakeholders at the country level.
  • Using the FCM MIR tools, provide formal reviews of the client’s travel program including analysis, commentary and recommendations pertinent to the client, their business plan and local supplier tactics. Reviews will be delivered on a maximum quarterly basis in a format agreed in the Service Level Agreement.
  • MAM to develop and maintain multi level client relationships.
  • Control the account management budget for the identified client portfolio. Actively work to recover all costs.
  • Quarterly provision and detailed analysis of client-generated income for multinational account management services, including correct accumulation of Multinational Account Management Fees and on-charge of additional fees as agreed with the client.
  • Work regularly with FCM Multinational Sales Leaders on new and existing business opportunities. Be active and contribute at team meetings and regional meetings.
  • Provide input into FCM’s one best way through monitoring competitive activity in the home and regional markets.

Afirmativa Mulher, Pref Negra: Pmo Projetos Sociais

Join to apply for the Afirmativa Mulher, Pref Negra: Pmo Projetos Sociais role at Fly Educação e Cultura

Afirmativa Mulher, Pref Negra: PMO Projetos Sociais – Praja Previsa de Serviço (PJ)

Local: Remoto, com preferência para São Paulo, Recife e Salvador
Modelo: Prestação de Serviço (PJ)
Duração: 8 a 12 meses, com possibilidade de renovação

A profissional selecionada irá atuar na função de PMO de Projetos Sociais na Fly Educação, prestando serviço de forma transversal aos nossos 4 departamentos centrais (Educação, Gente & Gestão, Comunicação e Relações Institucionais), garantindo que metas, indicadores e entregas dos projetos sociais sejam cumpridos com excelência, impacto e cuidado com as pessoas.

Responsabilidades da função

  • Gerenciar as operações do portfólio de projetos sociais, com foco em planejamento, execução, indicadores e resultados.
  • Acompanhar metas, cronogramas, prazos e orçamento dos projetos.
  • Apoiar a gestão de prestadores de serviço e garantir relatórios de qualidade.
  • Criar e monitorar indicadores, metas e fluxos operacionais eficientes entre os 4 departamentos.
  • Atuar junto a parceiros (prefeituras, redes de ensino, financiadores, etc.).
  • Contribuir com o fortalecimento institucional e estratégico da Fly.
  • Liderar o aprimoramento de processos e metodologias da organização.
  • Reportar para a Diretoria.

Requisitos para prestação do serviço

  • Experiência comprovada de 5 anos com gestão de projetos sociais e operacionais.
  • Vivência comprovada de 5 anos em gestão de mais de 10 pessoas em diferentes departamentos.
  • Formação em áreas como Administração, Gestão de Projetos, Educação, Políticas Públicas ou similares.
  • Conhecimento em ferramentas de gestão: Notion, Excel, Planilhas, Monday, Power BI, etc.
  • Boa comunicação, visão analítica e autonomia.
  • Comprometimento com a equidade racial e de gênero.

Diferenciais que valorizamos

  • Vivência com modelo de Prestação de Serviço: trabalho por entregas e autogestão de demandas/tempo.
  • Cases de sucesso comprováveis em alcance de indicadores de impacto e prestação de contas em projetos sociais.
  • Cases de incremento de permanência de alunos em projetos sociais.
  • Cases de alta retenção de equipe e prestadores de serviço em projetos sociais.
  • Paixão por desenvolver mulheres e juventudes dos grupos sub-representados.
  • Disponibilidade para visitas a parceiros e reuniões presenciais.

Dinâmica de trabalho

Entregas semanais: relatório de monitoramento (prazos, pendências, avanços)
Quinzenal: relatório executivo de OKRs para Diretoria
Mensal: relatório consolidado para Diretoria e Conselho
Semestral: revisão estratégica com Diretoria
Ambiente colaborativo e flexível, com propósito social forte.

Sobre a Fly Educação

Somos uma ONG pioneira em América Latina em desenvolver competências socioemocionais e científicas em jovens e mulheres de grupos sub-representados. Atuamos nacionalmente com projetos voltados à educação, tecnologia, empregabilidade, geração de renda e equidade racial e de gênero. Conheça mais sobre nosso trabalho: flyeducacao.org.br .

Envie seu portfólio com sua trajetória, cases de sucesso e pretensão de pagamento contratual mensal.

Truelogic is a leading provider of nearshore staff augmentation services headquartered in New York, delivering top‑tier technology solutions to companies of all sizes and helping them achieve digital transformation goals. Our team of 600+ highly skilled professionals based in Latin America drives digital disruption by partnering with U.S. companies on their most impactful projects.

Our client is a technology‑first creative network that blends engineering expertise and creative vision to solve complex business challenges. They partner with global brands to craft innovative, high‑impact digital experiences, leveraging AI and emerging technologies.

Job Summary

The AI Engineer will design, develop, and deploy AI‑powered solutions to enhance immersive, high‑performance web experiences for global clients. This position combines hands‑on technical work with strategic solution design, requiring expertise in machine learning algorithms, data processing, and AI infrastructure.

Responsibilities

  • Collaborate with cross‑functional teams to identify AI opportunities, gather requirements, and architect end‑to‑end solutions.
  • Design, develop, and implement machine learning and deep learning models using frameworks such as TensorFlow, PyTorch, scikit-learn, and LLM‑oriented tools.
  • Build and deploy AI agents using LangChain (or equivalent frameworks) for agentic development.
  • Oversee data collection, preprocessing, and feature engineering for high‑quality model inputs.
  • Train, fine‑tune, and evaluate models—including large language models (LLMs)—using large datasets and appropriate performance metrics.
  • Select, configure, and optimize AI infrastructure, tools, and frameworks on Google Cloud Platform (GCP), with exposure to AWS and Azure.
  • Ensure scalability, security, and efficiency in cloud‑based AI solutions.
  • Build prototypes and proof‑of‑concepts (POCs) to validate feasibility and potential impact.
  • Provide technical leadership and mentorship to AI development teams.
  • Stay informed on emerging AI trends and technologies, contributing innovative ideas to the company’s AI strategy.
  • Lead deployment of AI solutions into production, ensuring seamless integration with existing systems.
  • Ensure compliance with HIPAA and best practices for handling PII in AI‑driven systems.
  • Continuously optimize AI systems for performance, reliability, and accuracy.
  • Produce clear and comprehensive technical documentation.

Qualifications And Job Requirements

  • Proven track record as an AI Engineer, Machine Learning Engineer, Data Engineer, or AI Architect.
  • Strong programming skills in Python, with hands‑on experience in LangChain (or similar frameworks) for LLM‑based development.
  • Deep understanding of machine learning techniques, algorithms, and model evaluation methods.
  • Experience working with large language models (LLMs), fine‑tuning, and deploying them at scale.
  • Expertise with Google Cloud Platform (GCP), plus exposure to AWS and Azure.
  • Familiarity with big data technologies, data processing pipelines, and distributed computing.
  • Knowledge of compliance requirements such as HIPAA and best practices for handling PII data.
  • Excellent problem‑solving and analytical skills.
  • Strong communication skills for both technical and non‑technical audiences.
  • Demonstrated ability to lead technical initiatives, drive innovation, and mentor junior team members.

What we offer

  • 100% Remote Work: Work from any location with a laptop and reliable internet connection.
  • Highly Competitive USD Pay: Earn market‑leading compensation in USD.
  • Paid Time Off: Policies that allow you to unwind and recharge.
  • Work with Autonomy: Manage your time as long as results are delivered.
  • Work with Top American Companies: Grow your expertise on innovative projects for U.S. companies.

Why You’ll Like Working Here

  • A Culture That Values You: Well‑being and work‑life balance are prioritized.
  • Diverse, Global Network: Over 600 professionals across 25+ countries.
  • Team Up with Skilled Professionals: Work with senior talent in a supportive environment.

BotCity is building the future of automation with the Governance Platform for Python automations and AI Agents. Role Overview

The ITOps Analyst will handle all IT operational needs at BotCity (excluding product, engineering, and InfoSec), covering tasks from user provisioning to device management to infrastructure support. This role is crucial to ensuring that internal teams (sales, ops, marketing, etc.) can operate without IT friction or downtime.   • Escalate and coordinate with Engineering and Security teams when needed (e.g., deeper system issues).

Requisitos

  • Technical diploma in Information Systems, Systems Analysis or related degree.

  • Familiarity with device management (MDM), patching, endpoint security.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Exposure to basic scripting / automation (Shell, Python, PowerShell) to automate repetitive IT tasks.

title: Senior product designer
description:
Sobre a Lemon

As mudanças climáticas são um desafio complexo, mas as soluções não podem ser. Enquanto as ações climáticas forem de difícil acesso, nunca teremos um impacto unificado grande o bastante para fazer a diferença no planeta.

A Lemon é o jeito mais simples para empresas e pessoas impactarem positivamente o meio ambiente por meio de uma energia mais barata e limpa. Entregamos uma energia diferente da tradicional, por isso conseguimos oferecer uma conta de luz mais econômica e sustentável. Somos comprometidos com nossos clientes e com o planeta, por isso garantimos sempre um atendimento mais próximo e inovações que incentivam mudanças no setor elétrico.

Somos apoiados pelos principais investidores em tecnologia de todo o mundo, incluindo fundos de venture capital como Kaszek, Lowercarbon Capital, Canary, Big Bets e Actyus. Endereçar um dos desafios mais significativos do mundo requer pensamento inovador e perspectivas diversas. Estamos construindo um time de pessoas com diferentes experiências, repertório profissional e formações educacionais. Se você compartilha da nossa paixão de criar essa nova era da energia limpa, estamos ansiosos para conhecer o que de único você traz para Lemon.

Design na Lemon

Design na Lemon tem um papel estratégico para alcançar nossa missão. Como designer de produto, você terá protagonismo e voz para impactar a vida de milhares de pessoas com experiências simples e eficazes. Somos responsáveis por entender dores e necessidades dos clientes, levantar hipóteses, pesquisar, testar e projetar de ponta a ponta os produtos da Lemon. Atuamos lado a lado com Product Managers, Engenheiros e Data Analysts, em times colaborativos e orientados a resultados.

O que você vai fazer por aqui

  • Liderar o trabalho de design em áreas de produto do discovery à entrega incluindo fluxos, wireframes, protótipos e design visual;
  • Colaborar com PMs, engenheiros, researchers e marketing para criar experiências que conectem tecnologia e pessoas;
  • Contribuir na definição da estratégia de design e atuar na execução em áreas críticas do produto;
  • Traduzir desafios complexos em soluções claras, utilizáveis e envolventes;
  • Trazer a perspectiva de design para discussões de planejamento, priorização e trade-offs de produto;
  • Conduzir ou apoiar pesquisas com usuários e aplicar os aprendizados nas decisões de design;
  • Evoluir e manter nosso design system, promovendo consistência e escalabilidade;
  • Compartilhar seu trabalho com frequência, usando documentação, protótipos e sessões de feedback;
  • Representar e defender a voz do usuário, equilibrando necessidades do negócio e limitações técnicas.

O perfil que buscamos

  • Se entusiasma com problemas difíceis técnicos, de produto ou de negócio;
  • Tem experiência e gosta de colaborar com times multidisciplinares;
  • Se comunica de forma clara e confortável com diferentes públicos;
  • Tem interesse por sustentabilidade, energia ou sistemas complexos;
  • Já viveu experiências desafiadoras que fortalecem sua autonomia e confiança.

Experiência prévia / habilidades exigidas

  • 5+ anos de experiência em Product/UX Design, com portfólio digital relevante;
  • Histórico sólido em entregar experiências ponta a ponta em ambientes dinâmicos;
  • Excelência em design de interface e interação, com foco em soluções simples e funcionais;
  • Familiaridade com métodos de pesquisa e aplicação de insights no processo de design;
  • Conhecimento em arquitetura da informação, prototipação e usabilidade;
  • Capacidade de conduzir pesquisas qualitativas e quantitativas;
  • Boa compreensão de métricas, dados e KPIs de produto;
  • Conhecimento técnico suficiente para colaborar bem com desenvolvedores.

Experiência desejável

(não esperamos que você domine tudo valorizamos curiosidade e vontade de aprender)

  • Conhecimento em design comportamental e arquitetura da escolha;
  • Experiência na construção e evolução de Design Systems.

O que a gente oferece

  • Remuneração compatível com o mercado;
  • Trabalho remoto;
  • Materiais de escritório;
  • Coworking em todo o país;
  • Cartão Caju flexível (pode ser usado nas categorias alimentação, refeição, mobilidade, educação, saúde e cultura);
  • Plano de saúde;
  • Plano odontológico;
  • Programa de saúde mental e bem-estar (Zenklub);
  • Wellhub (Gympass);
  • Auxílio farmácia;
  • Lemon Feriados (além dos feriados nacionais, você tem alguns dias no ano à sua escolha para curtir uma folguinha ou emendar o descanso antes ou depois de um feriado).

Leia aqui por favor

Pesquisas mostram que pessoas que se identificam como homens candidatam-se a um trabalho quando consideram que cumprem 60% dos requisitos, já pessoas que se identificam como mulheres e outros grupos minorizados tendem a aplicar apenas quando preenchem todos os requisitos possíveis. Então, se você acredita que possui habilidades para mudar o futuro da energia no país com a gente, mas não necessariamente preenche tudo listado acima, por favor prossiga na vaga. Adoraríamos bater um papo e descobrir se você é quem estamos procurando.

Diversidade & inclusão

Aqui na Lemon a diversidade é um compromisso ético e, por isso, estamos engajados para nos tornarmos uma empresa cada vez mais diversa e caso se sinta confortável, gostaríamos de saber na sua candidatura se auto identifica/declara pertencente a algum ou alguns grupos de diversidade. Encorajamos que se candidatem pessoas com as mais diferentes histórias e vivências, pois isso nos auxilia a criar um ambiente mais inclusivo.

title: Mecânica Industrial I - Afirmativa para Mulheres

Descrição da empresa

Guiados por nosso objetivo e valores, promovemos alto desempenho e ação com foco no propósito de "Reimaginar a mineração para melhorar a vida das pessoas". Somos incondicionais diante a segurança, saúde e bem-estar de nossos empregados, seja no trabalho, em casa, e nas comunidades onde trabalhamos. Nosso objetivo é liderar o setor investindo em inovação para proteger as pessoas, que são o coração de nossos negócios. Nossas equipes assumem a responsabilidade por suas próprias ações e dos demais, trabalham de forma colaborativa e sempre demonstram cuidado e respeito. Com sede em Londres, Reino Unido, e operações localizadas em todo o mundo, a Anglo American é realmente uma empresa global. Empregamos mais de 60.000 colegas em todo o mundo e gerenciamos operações de mineração na África do Sul, América do Norte e do Sul e Austrália. No Brasil, atuamos com dois negócios: Minério de ferro, com Minas-Rio, localizado nos estados de Minas Gerais e Rio de Janeiro; e Níquel, com operações nos municípios de Barro Alto e Niquelândia, em Goiás. Além disso, temos estrutura corporativa localizada em Belo Horizonte. Estamos buscando talentos que compartilhem nossos valores e nossa crença em um futuro melhor, mais seguro, diverso e respeitoso para a mineração. Você pode ser um deles!

Descrição da vaga

Como Mecânica Industrial I você será responsável por executar as atividades de manutenção mecânica preventiva e corretiva em máquinas e equipamentos de Usina, atendendo a programações e solicitações de manutenção.

Veja abaixo as principais atividades:

  • Executar a manutenção nas máquinas e equipamentos, com orientação, desmontando, avaliando e reparando os defeitos, analisando falhas, trocando as peças danificadas, realizando testes etc.

  • Acompanhar retorno do equipamento pós manutenção

Qualificações

O perfil que estamos buscando para essa posição:

  • Ensino médio completo
  • Curso profissionalizante em mecânica
  • Desejável CNH - categoria B.
  • Residência em Conceição do Mato Dentro/MG, Serro/MG, Congonhas do Norte/MG, Dom Joaquim/MG ou Alvorada de Minas/MG.

Informações adicionais

Por que fazer parte do nosso time? Somos uma empresa empenhada em fazer nossas crenças e valores acontecerem de verdade. O objetivo é proporcionar a você um ambiente de qualidade, diverso e seguro para que você desenvolva o seu melhor. Para isso, oferecemos os melhores benefícios:

  • Para cuidar da sua saúde física e mental: Gympass, Plano de Saúde e Odontológico (extensivo a você e seus dependentes), além de Assistência Psicológica e Aplicativo Saúde Emocional
  • Especial para você e sua família: Auxílio Creche, Programa Família, Brinquedo de Natal e Vale Alimentação!
  • Espaço para ser você mesmo: Fique à vontade para participar de nossos Grupos de Afinidades e dos eventos incríveis da Semana da Diversidade!
  • Para seu futuro: Plano de Previdência Privada diferenciado
  • E ainda: Transporte fretado, refeições no local de trabalho, remuneração variável, Seguro de Vida, Apoio e orientação: Jurídico, financeiro, social e psicológico.

Compromisso com segurança e diversidade

Nada é mais importante do que garantir que você volte para casa com segurança após um dia de trabalho. Temos padrões de segurança rigorosos e investimos em tecnologias para tornar a mineração mais segura. Temos o compromisso de promover um ambiente de trabalho inclusivo e diversificado, onde valorizamos e respeitamos cada colega. Acolhemos todas as identidades de gênero, etnias, idades, espiritualidades, orientações sexuais, deficiências, classes sociais, estilos de vida e habilidades. Criamos Grupos de Afinidades para discutir, refletir e agir sobre inclusão e diversidade no âmbito da equidade de gênero, LGBTQIAP+, etnia, pessoas com deficiência e geracional.

Nós queremos colegas que se sintam valorizados, respeitados e abertos para trazer seu “verdadeiro eu” para o trabalho. Reforçamos que todas as vagas estão abertas para pessoas com deficiência (PcD) e reabilitados do INSS.

Processo seletivo

Para se candidatar a essa vaga, realize seu cadastro on-line, anexe seu currículo no ato da inscrição. Nosso processo seletivo, de forma geral, é constituído pelas seguintes etapas: inscrição, análise dos currículos, dinâmica/entrevista, avaliação comportamental, exame médico e admissão. Fique atento às comunicações (e-mail, telefone, WhatsApp), pois todo o processo será mediado por essas plataformas. Venha com a gente construir o futuro da mineração!

title: SEO Manager
description:
Overview

Join to apply for the SEO Manager role at RemotelyHR .

Location: Remote (Latin America, US time zones)

Salary Range: $1,500 - $3,000 per month (based on experience)

Employment Type: Contract (Flexible Monthly Agreement)

About French Florist French Florist is a leading luxury floral brand focused on providing premium floral arrangements while expanding its presence across the US. As we scale our operations through a franchise model and direct-to-consumer e-commerce, we are investing in a world-class marketing team to drive organic growth, brand authority, and customer acquisition.

We are seeking an SEO Manager who can own and execute a holistic SEO strategy—integrating technical SEO, on-page optimization, content strategy, link-building, and conversion optimization—to replace or complement our current agency-driven SEO model and significantly increase our organic search performance.

Responsibilities

  • Develop and execute a comprehensive SEO strategy to drive significant and sustainable organic growth.
  • Own technical SEO, on-page SEO, content SEO, and off-page SEO (link-building) to improve search rankings.
  • Conduct in-depth keyword research, competitive analysis, and SERP landscape assessments to identify high-impact opportunities.
  • Define SEO KPIs, benchmarks, and reporting processes to track organic performance and continuously optimize efforts.
  • Build a content strategy optimized for search intent, leveraging AI-driven insights, entity-based SEO, and structured data implementation.
  • Conduct and manage site audits to improve indexing, crawl efficiency, and overall site health.
  • Optimize site structure, URL taxonomy, internal linking, and schema markup for search engine visibility.
  • Improve page speed, Core Web Vitals, and mobile usability to enhance SEO performance and UX.
  • Ensure website responsiveness across all devices for a seamless and engaging user experience.
  • Collaborate with developers to implement SEO-friendly code, structured data, and technical fixes.
  • Optimize navigation structure and user flow to improve conversion rates and reduce bounce rates.
  • Develop and refine sitemaps, wireframes, and content hierarchies to create intuitive website experiences.
  • Leverage data-driven insights to map user journeys and optimize landing pages for search visibility and engagement.
  • Work closely with content writers to optimize blog posts, category pages, and product descriptions for SEO.
  • Develop a high-authority link-building strategy, securing quality backlinks through partnerships, PR, and content syndication.
  • Implement SEO-driven content frameworks, including topic clusters, pillar pages, and FAQ-rich snippets.
  • Work alongside PPC, email marketing, and brand teams to ensure holistic digital marketing synergy.
  • Train and educate teams on SEO best practices, ensuring SEO is deeply integrated across marketing and development.
  • Stay ahead of algorithm updates, industry trends, and AI-driven SEO advancements, adapting strategies accordingly.

Requirements & Qualifications

  • 5+ years of SEO experience, preferably with e-commerce, luxury brands, or franchise-based models in the US market.
  • Deep expertise in technical SEO, on-page optimization, content strategy, and link-building at scale.
  • Proven track record of SEO success, including ranking improvements, organic traffic growth, and revenue impact.
  • Strong proficiency with SEO tools (Google Analytics, Google Search Console, Ahrefs, SEMrush, Moz, Screaming Frog, etc.).
  • Experience with site migrations, domain authority growth, and multi-location SEO strategies.
  • Basic knowledge of HTML, CSS, and JavaScript (not required but a strong plus).
  • Strong analytical skills with the ability to turn data into actionable insights.
  • Comfortable working in a fast-paced, high-performance team with a strong focus on growth.

Why Join Us?

  • Own the SEO strategy for a high-growth luxury brand with massive market potential.
  • Work in a dynamic and entrepreneurial environment with a forward-thinking marketing team.
  • Have a direct impact on brand visibility, lead generation, and revenue growth.
  • Opportunity for career advancement as we scale into new markets and franchise locations.
  • Competitive compensation with flexibility in work arrangements.

Também é legal saber sobre nossos valores

Um dos nossos 7 valores é o “Sawabona”, seu significado é pra lá de especial e praticado diariamente aqui na Zappts. A saudação Sawabona se originou no Sul da África; quando alguém comete erros, a população celebra as coisas boas que aquela pessoa já fez e, ao final, cumprimenta com a expressão “Sawabona” e a resposta é “Shikoba”. Sawabona significa: “Eu te vejo, eu te respeito, você é importante para mim”. Shikoba: “Então eu sou bom e existo para você”. Aqui na Zappts, Sawabona traduz e representa o que mais prezamos em nossas relações: o respeito e a valorização do outro. Se você é apaixonado por tecnologia e sentiu conexão com os nossos valores, venha para nossa tribo!

title: Security Risk Management Specialist
description:
Overview

In security risk management we're looking to harness the power of industry best practice combined with driving new innovation on how we do security risk assessments and modelling. Our security risk management team is the primary owner of the strategy and practices of how we identify, track and reduce our security risk across everything we do. To support this we need to use industry best practices paired with emerging threat information to promote risk identification, quantification, impact analysis, and modelling to ultimately drive decision making. In this role, you will help establish and execute a broad strategic vision for the security risk program at Canonical. You will work within the team and cross-functionally with various teams across the organisation. The team contributes ideas and requirements for Canonical product security, improving the resilience and robustness of all Ubuntu customers and users subject to cyber attacks. Additionally, the team collaborates with our Organisational Learning and Development team to develop playbooks and facilitate security training across Canonical. The security risk management team's mission is not only to secure Canonical, but also to contribute to the security of the wider open source ecosystem. They might share knowledge through public presentations and industry events, and share threat intelligence with the wider community or represent Canonical in sector-specific governance bodies.

What you will do in this role

  • Define Canonical's security risk management standards and playbooks
  • Analyse and improve Canonical's security risk practices
  • Evaluate, select and implement new security requirements, tools and practices
  • Grow the presence and thought leadership of Canonical security risk management practice
  • Develop Canonical security risk learning and development materials
  • Work with Security leadership to present information and influence change
  • Participate in developing key risk indicators, provide inputs to the development of key control indicators, and key performance indicators for various programs
  • Apply statistical models to risk frameworks (such as FAIR, sensitivity analysis, and others)
  • Participate in risk management, decision-making, and collaborative discussions
  • Lead quantified risk assessments and understand the value of qualitative data for improvements to quality and engineering processes
  • Interpret internal or external cyber security risk analyses in business terms and recommend a responsible course of action
  • Develop templates and materials to help with self-service risk management actions
  • Monitor and identify opportunities to improve the effectiveness of risk management processes
  • Launch campaigns to perform security assessments and help mitigate security risks across the company
  • Build evaluation methods and performance indicators to measure efficiency of security functions and capabilities

What we are looking for

  • An exceptional academic track record
  • Undergraduate degree in Computer Science or STEM, or a compelling narrative about your alternative path
  • Drive and a track record of going above-and-beyond expectations
  • Deep personal motivation to be at the forefront of technology security
  • Leadership and management ability
  • Excellent business English writing and presentation skills
  • Problem-solver with excellent communication skills, a deep technical understanding of security assessments and risk management
  • Expertise in threat modelling and risk management frameworks
  • Broad knowledge of how to operationalize the management of security risk
  • Experience in Secure Development Lifecycle and Security by Design methodology

What we offer you

We consider geographical location, experience, and performance in shaping compensation worldwide. We revisit compensation annually (and more often for graduates and associates) to ensure we recognise outstanding performance. In addition to base pay, we offer a performance-driven annual bonus. We provide all team members with additional benefits, which reflect our values and ideals. We balance our programs to meet local needs and ensure fairness globally.

  • Distributed work environment with twice-yearly team sprints in person
  • Personal learning and development budget of USD 2,000 per year
  • Annual compensation review
  • Recognition rewards
  • Annual holiday leave
  • Maternity and paternity leave
  • Employee Assistance Programme
  • Opportunity to travel to new locations to meet colleagues
  • Priority Pass, and travel upgrades for long haul company events

About Canonical

Canonical is a pioneering tech firm at the forefront of the global move to open source. As the company that publishes Ubuntu, one of the most important open source projects and the platform for AI, IoT and the cloud, we are changing the world on a daily basis. We recruit on a global basis and set a very high standard for people joining the company. We expect excellence - in order to succeed, we need to be the best at what we do. Canonical has been a remote-first company since its inception in 2004. Working here is a step into the future, and will challenge you to think differently, work smarter, learn new skills, and raise your game.

Canonical is an equal opportunity employer. We are proud to foster a workplace free from discrimination. Diversity of experience, perspectives, and background create a better work environment and better products. Whatever your identity, we will give your application fair consideration.

Required Qualifications

  • Master\'s or PhD in Medical Microbiology, Immunology, or a closely related biomedical discipline.
  • Demonstrated expertise in core areas such as microbial pathogenesis, clinical diagnostics, virology, bacteriology, parasitology, and immunology.
  • Familiarity with laboratory procedures, microbiological instrumentation, and interpretation of diagnostic test results (e.g., blood cultures, PCR, AST).

Overview

Ledn is a global financial services company built for digital assets. We offer lending, savings and trading products to digital asset holders in over 150 countries. We are seeking an experienced engineer to join the Cybersecurity/IT Engineering team as a full-time Manager of IT. The ideal candidate will support end users, manage endpoints, automate identity and access management, and administer cloud-based IT systems and tools. This role reports to the Director of IT.

Responsibilities

  • Serve as customer-facing, the first line of support; own support via channels such as Slack and Jira; provide an outstanding support experience to employees.
  • Manage Mac endpoint and mobile device management tools (MDM/EMM, Jamf, etc.) and work with SaaS applications (Google Workspace, Slack, Jamf Pro, Jamf Protect, Jamf Connect, Okta, Jira, etc.).
  • Procure and deliver technology equipment; onboard new employees and retrieve tech from outgoing employees.
  • Design, test, build, and document programs, policies and tools; contribute improvements to existing knowledge bases.
  • Support and manage cloud-based IT systems and tools; contribute to improvements in identity and access management (IDP/SSO) across platforms (GSuite, Okta, etc.).
  • Set objectives and key results (OKRs) and align them with team and company goals; manage incidents and issues through resolution.
  • Work with Cybersecurity/IT peers and stakeholder teams (Customer Success, Marketing, Engineering, HR) and participate in agile project work (sprints, Jira).
  • Troubleshoot using terminal and enterprise macOS expertise; maintain a strong focus on automation, scripting, and infrastructure as code.
  • Provide remote support across multiple countries and time zones; understand networking fundamentals and OSI model troubleshooting.

What You Bring to Ledn

  • 7+ years in SaaS systems administration (e.g., Jamf Pro, Google Workspace, Okta, Slack, Jira, Netsuite).
  • Ability to create automations using bash, zsh, Python, etc.; experience with open source tools (Nudge, CIS Benchmark scripts, SplashBuddy, Munki, etc.).
  • Experience integrating SSO into Okta and creating workflows in Okta; strong API and system integration experience.
  • Remote support experience across multi-country teams; strong communication, clarity, and ability to manage expectations in diverse contexts.
  • Clear written communication (tickets, email, Slack) and customer-focused mindset.
  • Security minded with knowledge of PGP; basic networking and troubleshooting (TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP, VLANs, routing and switching).
  • Ability to self-manage, scope projects, and work across multiple teams.

Nice to Have

  • Some familiarity with AWS; experience with GAM and command-line tools.
  • Jamf certifications, Okta certifications, Google Workspace certifications.

Culture & Benefits

  • Culture fit: adaptable, resilient, collaborative, empathetic, integrity and accountability in handling confidential information.
  • Remote-friendly, global team; equity through shared ownership; remote work up to 180 days (subject to restrictions).
  • Comprehensive rewards package, including PTO and ownership in the company.
  • Inclusive, equal opportunity employer; accommodation requests available throughout the recruitment process.

Application Notes

We are a remote-first organization; due to high application volume, only qualified applicants will be contacted. Shortlisted candidates may be asked to submit a short video response and we may review publicly available social media relevant to the role. No agencies or recruiters, and we do not accept unsolicited agency resumes.

title: Northern California Senior Organizer
description:
About the Working Families Party

The Working Families Party (WFP) is the progressive party for the multiracial working class, fighting for a nation that works for the many, not the few. We recruit, train, and support transformational candidates up and down the ballot — and run them to win.

We believe that no matter where we come from or what our color, most of us want the same things. We want to earn enough to thrive, not just survive, and leave a better future for our kids. We want healthy food and clean water, safe neighborhoods and a safe world. We want to be free.

The Working Families Party is regular people coming together across our differences to make a better future for us all. We’re a multiracial party that fights for workers over bosses and people over the powerful. We want an America which realizes the promise – unrealized in our history – of freedom and equality for all.

Working Families Party is seeking a Senior Organizer based in Northern California to support our membership organizing and electoral programs for endorsed candidates, and to staff our regional steering committee of member affiliates and representatives across Northern California counties.

Essential Duties and Responsibilities

  • Cultivate a base of member leaders and volunteers to advance WFP’s electoral and party-building goals in Northern California
  • Grow California WFP dues paying members in the Bay Area
  • Lead in-person social events, political education, and campaign camps
  • Lead our electoral program for endorsed WFP candidates including volunteer trainings, canvasses/door knocks, text parties, house parties and more to organize members and supporters to elect WFP candidates and build the party
  • Build a team of local leaders who organize our membership and host gatherings utilizing a WFP culture grounded in creating welcoming and engaging spaces for multiracial working Californians.
  • Support and facilitate regional steering committee meetings
  • Navigate complex regional dynamics, competing interests, and multiple stakeholders
  • Track political and community landscape and integrate analysis into campaign strategy
  • Develop relationships with elected officials and endorsed candidates in the region
  • Manage contact lists and maintain accurate records in PDI, Every Action and other databases
  • Build strong relationships with WFP member affiliates and allies to strengthen our coalition and execute coordinated electoral and policy campaigns

Required Qualifications

  • Minimum of 5–7 years of in-person electoral, campaign, or neighborhood-based organizing experience
  • Demonstrated ability to cultivate relationships with labor, political clubs, grassroots organizations, and other social justice groups
  • Proven experience engaging and developing volunteers and supporters to build a political home and member journey
  • Experience working with diverse groups of volunteers and supporters across a wide range of demographics and backgrounds
  • Commitment to racial and economic justice
  • Valid driver’s license and access to a car

Skills and Competencies

  • Strong communication and active listening skills
  • Critical thinking and problem-solving abilities
  • Attention to detail and ability to manage the technical aspects of projects, including logistics and paperwork
  • Ability to multitask and adapt in a fast-paced environment
  • Self-starter with the ability to work independently and collaboratively
  • Knowledge of digital organizing tools and tactics, including social media platforms (Discord, Instagram, Facebook, Twitter) and EveryAction Network platforms
  • Basic computer skills, including proficiency with Excel, PowerPoint, Gmail, GSuite, Slack, and Airtable

Preferred (but Not Required) Skills

  • Experience working in labor and/or grassroots organizations in Northern California
  • Fluent in PDI, VAN, Votivate, or other voter file software and ability to cut turf
  • Experience working with phone bank tools including predictive dialer, broadcast SMS messaging (ThruTalk, CallHub, Hubdialer, Upland, Spoke, Hustle, etc.)
  • Experience using EveryAction for tracking volunteer activity
  • Strong command of Excel or other spreadsheet software
  • Bilingual Spanish/English, Mandarin/Cantonese/English, Korean/English, or Vietnamese/English is a plus

Salary & Compensation

$90,000 - $115,000 a year. The final salary will be determined based on an internal equitable scale that takes into consideration years of experience, geographic location, and final job description. We also offer a robust benefit package for full time employees including paid time off; health, dental, vision, and life insurance; flexible spending accounts; retirement plan options; professional development funding; and remote work support.

Location

The position is a full-time, permanent role remotely based in Northern California. It will require travel throughout the state of California.

Union Affiliation

WFP is a unionized workplace. This is a non managerial role eligible to join WFP's staff bargaining unit after six months of employment. WFP's union employees are represented by the New York Metropolitan Area Joint Board, Workers United union.

Applicants must be currently authorized to work for any employer in the U.S. We are unable to sponsor, or take over sponsorship of, employment visas at this time.

Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion

Working Families Party is an equal opportunity employer with a commitment to economic and social justice. Women, people of color, LGBTQ people, people with disabilities, and members of other historically disenfranchised populations are strongly encouraged to apply. Any applicant who requires an accommodation in order to apply for or perform the essential functions of the job should contact us at with the subject line "Application Accommodation" to request such an accommodation.

About the Role: We are seeking highly qualified professionals with Master’s or PhD in Medical Microbiology to support the development of state-of-the-art Large Language Models (LLMs). As a Rater / AI Trainer, you will play a critical role in shaping how AI understands and communicates complex biomedical knowledge, with a specific focus on microbiological sciences. This role involves evaluating AI-generated responses for scientific accuracy, contextual integrity, and clinical relevance within the field of medical microbiology. Your feedback and annotations will inform the improvement of AI systems used in healthcare education, diagnostics support, public health communication, and biomedical research.

  • Categorize model outputs using domain-specific taxonomies (e.g., pathogen type, disease process, diagnostic method).
  • Create real-world clinical or laboratory scenarios with researchers to design and test prompts to assess the model's reasoning and adaptability to professional contexts (e.g., interpreting culture reports, recommending diagnostic tests, understanding resistance profiles).

Required Qualifications

  • Master\u2019s or PhD in Medical Microbiology, Immunology, or a closely related biomedical discipline.
  • Demonstrated expertise in core areas such as microbial pathogenesis, clinical diagnostics, virology, bacteriology, parasitology, and immunology.
  • Familiarity with laboratory procedures, microbiological instrumentation, and interpretation of diagnostic test results (e.g., blood cultures, PCR, AST).
  • Excellent written communication skills and fluency in English. As part of the project, you are required to complete the English language assessment. The assessment is mandatory and non-billable.

description:
About Outliant

Outliant is a fully‑remote, US‑based digital product development and startup consulting company. Our culturally diverse team of creators builds seamless digital products. We pride ourselves on a pursuit of excellence, a startup mentality, and world‑class remote collaboration.

About the Role

We’re looking for a Tech Lead to join the Winona Engineering team. As a Tech Lead, you’ll be a trusted advisor and own the entire technical lifecycle for assigned projects. You’ll apply your broad range of specialized skills to tackle complex challenges, requiring innovative solutions and a deep understanding of technical concepts. You’ll independently plan and execute project development, fostering collaboration and resolving conflicts within the team.

  • Provide technical direction and leadership for a single team, making key decisions regarding architecture, frameworks, and tools.

  • Collaborate closely with engineers on a daily basis, contributing to hands‑on coding and implementation efforts.
  • Ensure code quality through rigorous code reviews, pair programming, and adherence to best practices.
  • Work with product managers and designers to translate business requirements into scalable and maintainable technical specifications.
  • Troubleshoot complex technical issues as they arise during development and deployment.

  • Prioritize and manage the technical workload effectively.
  • Conduct thorough code reviews and mentor team members to support their technical growth and quality output.
  • Foster a collaborative and supportive team environment, encouraging open communication and peer learning.
  • Identify potential technical conflicts or bottlenecks early and resolve them independently or collaboratively.
  • Stay current with emerging technologies, evaluating their relevance and potential for improving the development process.
  • Present technical work and conduct demos for clients with clear, confident communication.
  • Maintain clear, organized, and up‑to‑date technical documentation to ensure team alignment and knowledge sharing.

Qualifications

  • 6+ years of software development experience, including at least 1–2 years in a technical lead or equivalent leadership role.

  • Mastery of relevant programming languages, frameworks, and development tools.

  • Expertise in agile development methodologies and project management tools.
  • Demonstrated ability to plan, prioritize, and manage multiple concurrent projects.
  • Excellent problem‑solving and critical‑thinking skills.
  • Experience working with cloud platforms (e.g., AWS, Azure, Google Cloud) and containerization technologies (e.g., Docker, Kubernetes).
  • Strong leadership, mentorship, and task delegation capabilities.
  • Ability to adapt to evolving technologies and industry trends.
  • Experience in process improvement and driving change within a team or organization.

description:
Working modality: full time, home based in Brazil. Sponsor-dedicated.

The Site Payments Analyst plays a key role in ensuring accurate and timely payments to clinical trial sites.

Start-up Activities

  • Participate in Trial Oversight Meetings to gather updates on EDC structure and payment dependencies.

  • Set up country-specific fee templates and site fee schedules.

  • Coordinate with the Contract Manager to ensure payment terms are accurately reflected in the contract budget.

  • Provide feedback to CTM/CTL/PME regarding missing entries or discrepancies between programming and expected outputs during invoice request creation.

Study Conduct

  • Monitor and trigger payable items.

  • Track payment-related information and generate payment requests.

  • Send payment letters and communicate payment processes to sites, acting as the single point of contact (SPOC).

  • Validate invoices against completed services (via CTMS/CDMS or CRA confirmation) and contract terms.

  • Review invoice content, ensure accuracy in IVT, and initiate approval workflows.

  • Request updated invoices when discrepancies or missing information are identified.

  • Ensure compliance with GDPR by redacting personal data from site invoices when necessary.

  • Conduct financial reviews and support accrual reporting through relevant data and documentation.

Amendment Management

  • Update country fee templates and site payee information following contract amendments.

  • Terminate outdated fee schedules and implement new ones.

  • Reconcile payable items automatically when fees change and update flagged items as needed.

Study Close-Out

  • Ensure holdbacks are paid as per contractual agreements, in coordination with the CTM.

  • Confirm all outstanding invoices are settled prior to site close-out.

  • Monitor pending payment requests, including those not yet invoiced post-closeout.

What We’re Looking For

  • Bachelor's Degree in Business Administration, Finance or related.
  • 2 to 4 years of Site Payments experience.
  • Fluent English (spoken, written and read).
  • Computer skills including proficient use of Microsoft Word and Excel.

  • Ability to establish and maintain effective working relationships with coworkers, managers and clients.

Why Join Us?

Overview

Trustly is a global leader in Open Banking Payments delivering a smarter, faster, and more secure financial future. About the team

Trustly\'s DataOps team delivers data generated by applications to interested areas, as well as data from APIs and other tools, in a safe, structured, scalable, and generic way. We work across multiple environments (in different regions) and maintain consistency. We handle batch and streaming data (using Airflow and Kafka), aid in process automation to deliver data quickly and reliably, and focus on data quality by creating an observability layer to address inconsistencies and failures. We support data products and services to facilitate data use, maintaining tools such as Redshift and QuickSight. We collaborate with the Data Science area to provide the necessary support and infrastructure for model production. Who you are

  • Experience with relational databases (PostgreSQL, MySQL, SQL Server, etc.).
  • Experience with Apache Airflow and Big Data solutions (Kafka, EMR, Glue, etc.).
  • Experience with Redshift, DBT, QuickSight.
  • Experience in Big Data.
  • Technical leadership, collaborative mindset, holistic & architectural thinking, autonomy & proactivity.
  • Clear & objective communication, attention to detail & quality focus, mentoring, adaptability, resilience & critical thinking.
  • Advanced proficiency in English.
